name: New Area: Clubhouse
description: EXPERIMENTAL example of adding a brand-new map by mod: registers a new interior (the FUN CLUBHOUSE, cloned from a vanilla one-room house so it renders), adds a warp into it from Pallet Town, and populates it with a host NPC that gives a one-time gift. A worked template for new areas. The Pallet entrance tile is a best guess - verify it in game and refine the entrance in Tiled.
